trap.label: put down to
trap.why: Atribuir “por/para” leva o brasileiro a usar for. Em inglês: attribute A to B ou put A down to B.

mcq.q: Put the failure ___ to weak execution.

opts: Provided that you pay, we start.
Provided you will pay, we start.

fix.wrong: They put the failure up to luck.
fix.right: They put the failure down to luck.

fix.wrong: As long as you will pay, we start.
fix.right: As long as you pay, we start.

rewrite.prompt: Use put down to: “They attribute the loss to error.”
rewrite.answer: They put the loss down to error.

rewrite.prompt: Use as long as: “We start only if you pay.”
rewrite.answer: We start as long as you pay.

rewrite.prompt: Use attribute: “Failure is due to execution.” (Managers…)
